ITEM 1 | Dark green spinach-like leaves, flat and wilted-looking, scattered across the center and left of a white square plate, covering roughly 30% of the plate footprint, with moist glossy sheen, about 1 cm thick in clumps | 45
ITEM 2 | Thin orange carrot matchsticks, bright orange, about 4-6 cm long and 0.3 cm wide, scattered among the leaves, slightly glossy and crisp-looking | 12
ITEM 3 | Dried red cranberry-like pieces, deep red, wrinkled and semi-translucent, about 0.5-1 cm each, scattered in the center-right, dry matte surface | 8
ITEM 4 | Golden raisin-like pieces and small pale yellow-tan flakes, dry and slightly wrinkled, scattered in the center among the greens, about 0.5 cm each | 5
ITEM 5 | Sliced almond-like pale tan slivers, dry and matte, scattered across the center, about 0.3-0.5 cm each | 4
ITEM 6 | Dark brown seared meat chunks, browned and slightly charred at edges, cut into irregular pieces about 2-3 cm across, on the upper right of the greens with a firm, dry-looking surface | 30
ITEM 7 | Thin pale translucent onion-like slices, glistening and slightly moist, lying under the greens on the upper left, about 3-4 cm long and 0.3 cm thick | 8
ITEM 8 | Clear to amber glossy dressing or oil sheen coating the leaves and ingredients, thin film with light pooling on the plate near the center | 6
